name: price-oracle
description: Confidence-aware multi-source price feed for Bitcoin and Ethereum

scripts.dev:core: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names mock,agg,web -c yellow,cyan,green 'pnpm --filter @price-oracle/ingestor-mock dev' 'pnpm --filter @price-oracle/aggregator dev' 'pnpm --filter @price-oracle/dashboard dev'
scripts.dev:full: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names mock,binance,coinbase,kraken,agg,web -c yellow,blue,magenta,red,cyan,green 'pnpm --filter @price-oracle/ingestor-mock dev' 'pnpm --filter @price-oracle/ingestor-binance dev' 'pnpm --filter @price-oracle/ingestor-coinbase dev' 'pnpm --filter @price-oracle/ingestor-kraken dev' 'AGGREGATOR_SOURCES=binance,coinbase,kraken,mock pnpm --filter @price-oracle/aggregator dev' 'pnpm --filter @price-oracle/dashboard dev'
scripts.dev:real: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names binance,coinbase,kraken,agg,web -c blue,magenta,red,cyan,green 'pnpm --filter @price-oracle/ingestor-binance dev' 'pnpm --filter @price-oracle/ingestor-coinbase dev' 'pnpm --filter @price-oracle/ingestor-kraken dev' 'AGGREGATOR_SOURCES=binance,coinbase,kraken pnpm --filter @price-oracle/aggregator dev' 'pnpm --filter @price-oracle/dashboard dev'
